# Home Snagging UK

> > Professional new-build property inspection and snagging survey services across Yorkshire, Nottingham, and the Midlands, specializing in RPSA-accredited defect detection with thermal imaging and drone technology.

Home Snagging UK provides comprehensive pre-completion and post-completion snagging inspections for new-build homes and commercial properties. Their RPSA-certified inspectors use advanced thermal imaging and drone roof inspection to identify construction defects, helping homeowners leverage NHBC Buildmark and other warranties to ensure quality standards.

## Key Topics

- Snagging inspection services
- New-build property defects
- NHBC Buildmark warranty coverage
- RPSA accreditation standards
- Thermal imaging inspection
- Drone roof inspection
- Pre-completion surveys
- Post-completion surveys
- Construction quality assurance
- Building regulations compliance
- Yorkshire and Nottingham coverage
- Common new-build snags
- Property resale value protection
- Commercial snagging surveys
